title: Stability and outcome after two approaches for counterclockwise mandibular setback in patients with skeletal class III high-angle malocclusion: a prospective study
html: Patients of skeletal class III high-angle malocclusion have different clinical entities. This prospective study aimed to compare stability and outcomes following two approaches for counterclockwise mandibular setback in bimaxillary rotational surgery to correct skeletal class III high-angle malocclusion. Fifty-six adult patients with skeletal class III high-angle malocclusion who underwent surgery-first bimaxillary surgery with counterclockwise mandibular setback were analyzed. Patients were grouped by different direction of mandibular distal segment: posterior-shortening (n = 25) and posterior-lengthening (n = 31).
